words.definition: showing firm and constant support
words.example: The brand rewards its loyal customers with special offers.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個品牌會用特別優惠回饋忠誠顧客。

words.definition: a formal lunch, often for a special occasion
words.example: The retirement luncheon will be held in the main dining room.
words.exampleTranslation: 退休午宴將在主餐廳舉行。

words.definition: a device used to make sound louder or to record it
words.example: Please speak clearly into the microphone during the presentation.
words.exampleTranslation: 簡報時請對著麥克風清楚說話。

words.definition: a general summary of something
words.example: The report begins with an overview of last year's results.
words.exampleTranslation: 這份報告以去年結果的概述作為開頭。

words.definition: a device that displays images or video onto a screen
words.example: The projector in the conference room needs a new bulb.
words.exampleTranslation: 會議室的投影機需要換一顆新燈泡。

words.definition: a situation in which there is not enough of something
words.example: The factory is dealing with a shortage of raw materials.
words.exampleTranslation: 工廠正面臨原物料短缺的問題。

words.definition: having a lot of space; roomy
words.example: The new office has a spacious meeting area.
words.exampleTranslation: 新辦公室有一個寬敞的會議區域。

words.definition: something successfully achieved
words.example: Completing the merger was a major accomplishment for the team.
words.exampleTranslation: 完成這次合併對團隊來說是一項重大成就。

words.definition: to make someone familiar with something through experience
words.example: New hires need time to accustom themselves to the software.
words.exampleTranslation: 新進員工需要時間讓自己習慣這套軟體。

words.definition: a place where medical treatment is given, often for a specific purpose
words.example: The company arranged an on-site flu clinic for employees.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司安排了現場流感疫苗診所給員工使用。

words.definition: a personal computer designed for stationary use on a desk
words.example: Each cubicle is equipped with a desktop computer.
words.exampleTranslation: 每個隔間都配有一台桌上型電腦。

words.definition: to run at a slow, steady pace, usually for exercise
words.example: Many employees jog around the building during their lunch break.
words.exampleTranslation: 許多員工會利用午休時間繞著大樓慢跑。

words.definition: free time when one is not working
words.example: The resort offers plenty of leisure activities for guests.
words.exampleTranslation: 這間度假村為房客提供許多休閒活動。

words.definition: a short period of sleep, especially during the day
words.example: The office added a quiet room where staff can take a short nap.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室新增了一間安靜的房間，讓員工可以小睡片刻。

words.definition: to strengthen or support something
words.example: The training session helped reinforce our safety procedures.
words.exampleTranslation: 這場訓練有助於強化我們的安全流程。

words.definition: a person who sends something, such as a letter or package
words.example: Contact the sender if the package arrives damaged.
words.exampleTranslation: 如果包裹送達時已損壞，請聯繫寄件人。

words.definition: a device that cleans by sucking up dirt and dust
words.example: The cleaning crew uses a vacuum every evening after closing.
words.exampleTranslation: 清潔人員每天打烊後都會用吸塵器清潔。

words.definition: operating without wires, using radio signals
words.example: The conference room has a stable wireless connection.
words.exampleTranslation: 會議室有穩定的無線網路連線。

words.definition: happening once a year
words.example: The yearly performance review is scheduled for next month.
words.exampleTranslation: 年度績效考核排定在下個月進行。

words.definition: recognition and enjoyment of the value of something; gratitude
words.example: The manager expressed appreciation for the team's extra effort.
words.exampleTranslation: 經理對團隊的額外努力表達了感激。
